raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Senior Business Analyst   BFS
| Client: Central Bank of Kuwait | Dec 2021 Present
Key Result Areas:
Prepared and maintained BRDs, FSDs, functional specifications, use cases, process
flows, and user stories, providing clear requirements to development teams.
Played  a key role in  the  ISO 20022  MT to MX  migration  for  the  Central  Bank  of
Kuwait, ensuring compliance with regulatory and SWIFT standards.
Worked closely with business stakeholders  and subject matter experts to gather,
analyze,  and  validate  business  requirements  for  payment  transformation
initiatives.
Utilized  Microsoft  Copilot  for  requirement  analysis,  FSD  drafting,  user  story
creation,  test  scenario identification,  and  test  case  generation,  contributing  to
improved productivity and documentation quality.
Actively  participated  in  Agile  ceremonies  including  sprint  planning,  backlog
refinement, requirement walkthroughs, and stakeholder review sessions.
Led  SIT  and  UAT  activities,  including  test  planning,  test  execution,  defect
management, retesting, and business sign-off.
Performed end-to-end functional testing, regression testing, data validation, and
accounting validation across payment processing workflows.
Strong  Hands-on  experience  in  analysis  and  testing  of  ISO  20022  payment
messages, including pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.009 COV, pacs.004, and pacs.002..
Executed SQL data validation, reconciliation activities, and backend verification to
ensure transaction accuracy and data integrity.
Performed  REST  API  and  SoapUI  testing,  validating  request/response  payloads
and integration workflows across payment systems.
Coordinated  with  development,  infrastructure,  SWIFT,  and  business  teams  to
resolve defects and ensure successful implementation of releases.
Supported  production  deployments,  post-release  validation,  issue  triage,  and
stabilization activities for critical payment applications.
Highlights:
Played a key role in the successful implementation and go-live of the ISO 20022 MT-
to-MX migration program, ensuring compliance with SWIFT and regulatory
requirements.
CSB Bank Limited | Branch Manager Retail Operations | Business Analyst Core Banking | Nov 2009 Nov 2021
Business Analyst Core Banking - Nov 2014 Nov 2021
Key Result Areas:
Gathered and analyzed business requirements for Core Banking System (CBS) enhancements and prepared Functional Specification
Documents (FSDs).
Coordinated with business users and developers to deliver system enhancements and regulatory changes.
Performed impact analysis, requirement walkthroughs, and functional validation of banking solutions.
Executed manual, functional, and regression testing; supported SIT and UAT activities.
Performed SQL-based data validation and supported deployment, release verification, and production issue resolution.
Participated in Agile ceremonies and acted as a bridge between business and technology teams.
Branch Manager Retail Operations - Nov 2009 Oct 2014
Key Result Areas:
Managed end-to-end branch operations, ensuring achievement of business, service, and compliance objectives.
Drove growth in CASA, NRI, retail, and MSME portfolios through customer acquisition and relationship management.
Led cross-selling of liability and asset products including Business, Home, Personal, and Vehicle Loans.
Managed HNI customer relationships and ensured superior customer service delivery.
Monitored branch performance, profitability, and regulatory compliance while leading branch teams to achieve business targets.
Highlights:
Ranked 3rd PAN India as Best Branch Manager (FY 2012 2013) for consistently exceeding annual business and performance targets.
Recognized with multiple quarterly awards for sustained excellence in sales performance, revenue growth, and customer acquisition.
Drove process and system improvements by recommending functional enhancements to internal banking software, successfully
implemented in collaboration with IT teams.
Adaequare Info Pvt. Ltd. | Java Developer | April 2008 - Oct 2009
Key Result Areas:
Designed, developed, and maintained Java-based applications and web solutions in line with business and technical requirements.
Contributed to software design and architecture discussions, supporting scalable and maintainable application frameworks.
Developed efficient, reusable, and testable code, following coding standards and best practices.
Performed application analysis, unit testing, debugging, and defect resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables.
Troubleshot production issues, prepared technical and design documentation, and recommended enhancements to improve
application performance and stability.
